mainEntity.name: How can I tell which past alterations are worth keeping and which should be reversed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Evaluating alterations involves understanding the building’s evolution, the quality of the work, and whether changes have gained their own significance over time. A preservation-minded designer can help distinguish between valuable layers of history and intrusive modifications that undermine the original design.
